in_text_mentions: Here, we present case details of three term babies (Figure 1) who were born out of non-consanguineous marriage with appropriate birth weight for gestational age. They had unilateral cleft lip and palate (UCLP). One baby had an additional deformity of polydactyly of the left hand and preauricular sinus (Figure 2). The second baby showed multicystic kidney disease on a kidney, ureter, and bladder (KUB) scan (Figure 3).

Reviewed initial computed tomography obtained on admission contained a small mass in front of the right tragus (Fig. 2).
